description: Facility business plan: capex (HeroX price from the pricing engine for air domes, site works, fit-out, contingency), court revenue model, operating costs (energy for inflation/heating/lighting, staff, maintenance, insurance), optional HeroX financing, EBITDA, payback and a 10-year cash flow, with every assumption listed. Write it up for the user as a clear plan with a table, and invite them to replace defaults with local numbers (court rates, energy prices, staff). Planning model, not financial advice.

climate.description: Sizes the heating: hot (Dubai), mild (Brussels), cold (New York), veryCold (Columbus OH), extremelyCold (Montreal). Pick the closest to the site.

courts.description: Number of courts (or fields / pools). Used to size the dome when dimensions are unknown.

financed.description: Use HeroX financing (10% down, 8% APR) on the HeroX scope.

include_mechanical.description: Air domes only: include the inflation and heating unit (false if an existing unit is reused).

length_ft.description: Footprint length in feet, if known.

length_m.description: Footprint length in metres (alternative to feet).

other_revenue_pct.description: Memberships, coaching, events as % of court revenue. Default 20.

rate_per_court_hour_usd.description: Rental price per court-hour (field-hour for soccer). Defaults by sport and region.

region.description: north_america is quoted in USD and feet; everywhere else in EUR and metres.

spec.description: seasonal = single layer, winter-only; standard = double layer; insulated = year-round insulated (most common in cold climates); premium = highest insulation.

structure_type.description: air_dome = air-supported (inflated) dome; frame_hall = aluminium-frame fabric building (no inflation, openable sides possible).

width_ft.description: Footprint width in feet, if known.

width_m.description: Footprint width in metres (alternative to feet).

name: build_business_plan
title: Build a dome business plan
